ambiguities.aspect: areset semantics (asynchronous vs synchronous vs edge-triggered)
readings: areset is an asynchronous level-sensitive reset: asserting areset immediately clears q to 0 and holds it cleared while areset is asserted, independent of clk
areset is a synchronous reset sampled on posedge clk: q clears only at the next rising clock edge while areset is asserted
areset is an asynchronous positive-edge-triggered reset: q clears only on the rising edge of areset, not while areset is held high
areset is active-high: reset when areset=1
areset is active-low: reset when areset=0
areset has highest priority: when areset is asserted, q becomes 0 even if load=1 or ena=1
load/ena have priority over reset: when areset is asserted and load=1, q loads data (or shifts if ena=1) instead of clearing
